Arre wah, cricket mein sixer maara—ball seedha boundary ke paar! Is baat par hum is sawaal ke turant baad wapas aayenge. Is aayat ke kinaare par ek baar dhaaga lagana hai. Kitna dhaaga lagega?

Dhoondhna hai: baad ki lambai, yaani kyari ka parimap. Ab agla kadam dekhte hain.
